audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Hebrew-grounded restored draft of 2 Chronicles 29; variant readings and name-forms flagged; YHWH rendered for יהוה.

verses.restored: Hezekiah began to reign at five-and-twenty years of age; he reigned nine-and-twenty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, daughter of Zechariah.

familiar.text: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

verses.restored: And he did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, according to all that David his father had done.

familiar.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

verses.restored: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the daltot (doors) of the house of YHWH and strengthened them.

familiar.text: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.

verses.restored: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them to the east street (rechov hamizrach).

familiar.text: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

verses.restored: He said to them, "Hear me, Levites: sanctify yourselves now and sanctify the house of YHWH, the God of your fathers; carry out the filthiness from the sanctuary."

familiar.text: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.

verses.restored: For our fathers trespassed and did evil in the eyes of YHWH our God; they forsook him and turned their faces from the dwelling of YHWH and turned their backs.

familiar.text: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.

verses.restored: They shut the doors of the porch, put out the lamps, did not burn incense nor offer burnt offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

familiar.text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.

verses.restored: Therefore the fierce anger of YHWH was upon Judah and Jerusalem; he delivered them to terror, to astonishment and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.

familiar.text: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

notes.title: variant
notes.body: Hebrew has a variant in the clause (לזועה / לְזַעֲוָה); meaning ranges between 'to terror/astonishment' — textual witnesses should be reviewed.

verses.restored: For behold, our fathers fell by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity because of this.

familiar.text: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

verses.restored: Now with a whole heart I will make a covenant with YHWH the God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

familiar.text: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

verses.restored: My sons, be not now negligent; for YHWH has chosen you to stand before him, to serve him and to minister and to burn incense.

familiar.text: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

verses.restored: Then the Levites rose: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah, of the sons of Kohath; and of the sons of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah.

familiar.text: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

verses.restored: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shimri and (variant) Jeiel; and of the sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

notes.title: variant
notes.body: Hebrew shows a variant form (ויעואל / וִיעִיאֵל) for the second name; witnesses differ on vocalization and consonants.

verses.restored: Of the sons of Heman: (variant) Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

notes.title: variant
notes.body: Hebrew gives an alternate here (יחואל / יְחִיאֵל) for the first name; record flagged for witness study.

verses.restored: They gathered their brethren, sanctified themselves, and came, according to the king’s commandment and the word of YHWH, to cleanse the house of YHWH.

familiar.text: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: The priests went into the inner part of the house of YHWH to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the sanctuary into the court of the house of YHWH; and the Levites carried it out to the brook Kidron outside.

familiar.text: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

verses.restored: They began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day they came to the porch of YHWH; so they sanctified the house of YHWH for eight days; on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

familiar.text: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

verses.restored: They came in to Hezekiah the king and said, "We have cleansed all the house of YHWH, the altar of burnt offering and all its vessels, and the table of arrangement (shewbread) and all its vessels."

familiar.text: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

verses.restored: Moreover, all the vessels which King Ahaz in his reign had cast away in his transgression, we have prepared and sanctified; behold, they are before the altar of YHWH.

familiar.text: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD.

verses.restored: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of YHWH.

familiar.text: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

verses.restored: They brought seven bullocks, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven he-goats for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah; and he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of YHWH.

familiar.text: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD.

verses.restored: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar; likewise with the rams and the lambs they sprinkled the blood on the altar.

familiar.text: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

verses.restored: They presented the he-goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; they laid their hands upon them.

familiar.text: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

verses.restored: The priests killed them and made atonement with their blood on the altar to make reconciliation for all Israel; for the king had commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering be made for all Israel.

familiar.text: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

verses.restored: He set the Levites in the house of YHWH with cymbals, psalteries and harps, according to the commandment of David and Gad the king’s seer and Nathan the prophet; for by the hand of YHWH was the command by his prophets.

familiar.text: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.

notes.title: context
notes.body: The Levitical musical arrangement echoes Davidic models (see 1 Chronicles 15–25).

verses.restored: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

familiar.text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

verses.restored: Hezekiah commanded the offering of the burnt offering on the altar; and when the burnt offering began, the song of YHWH began with the trumpets and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

familiar.text: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

verses.restored: All the congregation worshipped; the singers sang, and the trumpets sounded — all until the burnt offering was finished.

familiar.text: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

verses.restored: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshipped.

familiar.text: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

verses.restored: Hezekiah and the princes commanded the Levites to praise YHWH with the words of David and of Asaph the seer; and they praised until they were glad, and bowed and worshipped.

familiar.text: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

verses.restored: Then Hezekiah said, "Now that you have consecrated yourselves to YHWH, draw near and bring sacrifices and thank-offerings into the house of YHWH." And the congregation brought sacrifices and thank-offerings; and as many as were of a free heart brought burnt offerings.

familiar.text: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

verses.restored: The number of the burnt offerings that the congregation brought was seventy bullocks, a hundred rams, and two hundred lambs — all for burnt offerings to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

verses.restored: And the consecrated things (the sacred gifts) were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

familiar.text: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

verses.restored: But the priests were few and could not skin all the burnt offerings; so their brethren the Levites helped them until the work was finished and the priests had sanctified themselves; for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

familiar.text: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

verses.restored: There were many burnt offerings with the fat of the peace-offerings, and drink-offerings for every burnt offering; thus the service of the house of YHWH was established.

familiar.text: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

verses.restored: Hezekiah rejoiced and all the people, because God (ha-Elohim) had prepared the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

familiar.text: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

translation_notes: Rendered יהוה as YHWH. Kept ritual and cultic terms literal (e.g., daltot, mizbeach). Preserved bracketed/variant name-forms from the Hebrew where present and flagged verses needing witness review.
Kept theological and violent material unchanged per project rules; mystical_translation is contemplative and separate.
safety_note: Contains ritual violence, sacrificial killing, and language about conquest/captivity; reader discretion advised.
